facts.fact: WalawPress reports the CNDP communiqué of 2026-08-28 restating obligations under Law 09-08 'en vigueur', including prior notification (article 12) and explicit consent for political-opinion data (article 21).
The CNDP's 2026-08-28 communiqué is guidance on Law 09-08 for the election campaign, with a 3020 line; the report states no sanction or decision.
The CNDP issued a communiqué dated 2026-08-28 to political parties and voters on their duties under Law 09-08 for the 23 September 2026 legislative elections, and opened a 3020 information line.
